notes.title: Update 0.0.5
notes.content:
To access the new build, go to local files, and click on game.exe

The Newest Update Is Here!

With this update, I have planted the foundation for the majority of the game, and the game will be sailing smoothly after the demo crunch.

Current patch notes:

-Beginning Tutorial Added

-Body Added

-Body Movement Added

-Fixed Bug Where NPCs Wouldn't Disappear

-Added A Timelimit Of 3 Days (6 Hours)
